pendientes: INGLÉS · Traducción con IA del texto aprobado de servicios.json (2026-11-20). Rik revisa y aprueba la versión en inglés completa antes de publicarla.

INGLÉS · H1: 'Servicios de inteligencia artificial para empresas, conectados en un solo sistema' → 'AI services for businesses, connected in one system' (más corto y natural; 'AI' es como se busca en inglés). La palabra resaltada (lit) pasa de 'inteligencia artificial' a 'AI services'.
INGLÉS · Etapas: Atraer · Atender · Organizar · Automatizar · Medir → Attract · Respond · Organize · Automate · Measure (las mismas que en /en/). Los 'tramos' de #conexion quedaron como 'steps'.

INGLÉS · Todos los enlaces a servicios, /kommo/, /gohighlevel/ y /metodologia/ siguen en español (esas páginas no tienen versión en inglés). Un visitante de /en/services/ cae en páginas en español al hacer clic; confirma si se aceptan así o si se pintan como texto sin enlace.

INGLÉS · 'GoHighLevel en español' → 'GoHighLevel in Spanish' / 'set up in Spanish'. Para un cliente de Estados Unidos puede sonar raro; confirma si se queda, se reescribe o sale de la versión en inglés.

INGLÉS · 'Somos partner oficial' de Kommo (mapa) y 'Somos partners de Kommo, GoHighLevel, Google y Meta' (conexion.note) se tradujeron tal cual. El glosario dice 'Kommo como único partner': confirma cuál vale en inglés y si el partnership de Kommo (Latinoamérica) cubre clientes de Estados Unidos y Canadá.
INGLÉS · vktor.lede conserva el plazo confirmado ('7 to 30 days, depending on scope'), sin agregar promesas.
INGLÉS · 'Planes {{price}}' → 'Plans {{price}}'. Se asume que {{price}} en inglés se pinta como 'from USD 997 a month' (todavía no existe la versión en inglés de PRICE_FROM).
INGLÉS · #no-se: la plantilla abre el formulario de cotización con 'No estoy seguro' marcado; el formulario sigue en español. Hace falta su versión en inglés (aviso para quien construye).

definition.heading: What AI services does Ingeniak offer?
definition.text: Ingeniak designs, implements and runs an AI-powered sales system: it generates demand with ads, web and SEO; handles it with AI agents on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, your website chat and email; organizes it in Kommo or GoHighLevel; automates the repetitive work with n8n and Make; and measures everything in one dashboard.

body: You can hire each service on its own, but they're built to connect: the lead an ad brings in lands in the same conversation, the same CRM and the same dashboard. That's why we start with the piece you need most and lay the groundwork to add the rest, with AI and our team working alongside you.

h2.soft: five stages of the same customer.

mapa.lede: Organized by what they do for each customer: bring them in, respond to them, organize them, automate what comes next and measure what happened.

items.title: Paid media
items.line: Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns connected to your CRM, so you measure sales, not clicks.

items.title: High-converting websites
items.line: Fast sites that turn visits into conversations, with WhatsApp and your CRM built in.

items.title: SEO and AI visibility
items.line: Get found on Google and get your brand cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude.

items.title: Branding and content
items.line: Identity, visual system and content that feed your campaigns, your website and your agents.

items.title: AI agents for WhatsApp
items.line: Kain answers, qualifies and books on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, your website and email.

items.title: AI-powered CRM
items.line: We help you choose between Kommo and GoHighLevel and get it running with your team.

items.title: Kommo
items.line: We're an official partner: licenses, implementation and AI agents inside Kommo.

items.title: GoHighLevel in Spanish
items.line: CRM, funnels, calendars and campaigns in one platform, set up in Spanish.

groups.label: Automate
groups.line: Repetitive work stops running through you.

items.title: Automation with n8n
items.line: Workflows that connect your CRM, WhatsApp, spreadsheets and systems, with no manual data entry.

items.title: Custom software
items.line: When no tool fits: systems and dashboards built for your operation, with AI built in.

groups.label: Measure
groups.line: Decide with data, not gut feelings.

items.title: AI consulting
items.line: Diagnosis, roadmap and use cases with measurable ROI, using the VKTOR™ methodology.

mapa.closing: Plans {{price}}. We define the scope of each piece with you when you request a quote.

h2.soft: Tell us and we'll figure it out with you.

no-se.lede: Use the form to tell us how you handle inquiries, sell and follow up today, and we'll work out with you what to automate first. These are the three signs we see most often:

items.pain: More people message you than you can keep up with.
items.fix: We start with response: an AI agent on your channels.

items.pain: Your leads live in chats, notebooks and spreadsheets.
items.fix: We start with organization: a CRM your team will actually use.

items.pain: You pay for ads and don't know which campaign sells.
items.fix: We start with measurement: campaigns connected to your CRM.

h2.text: Every service goes through the same protocol,

vktor.lede: Implementing a piece takes 7 to 30 days, depending on scope. The order and the tools are decided in phase K, not before.

phases.name: Verify
phases.line: We look at how your customers arrive, how they're handled and where you're losing them today.

phases.name: Koncept
phases.line: We choose which piece goes first, with which tools and what connects to what.

phases.name: Transform
phases.line: We build and connect the piece, and test it before we switch it on.

phases.name: Operate
phases.line: We train your team, then review and fine-tune in production.

phases.name: Rise
phases.line: We measure, and add the next piece once the previous one is delivering results.
